rules.title: Small conductor on too large a breaker
rules.paraphrase: A small branch-circuit conductor may not be protected by an overcurrent device larger than the limit the code sets for its size and material, whatever its ampacity. The inspector reads each conductor entry's own published rating, never a size-to-amperes table.

rules.title: Metal box not bonded
rules.paraphrase: Where an equipment grounding conductor is spliced in or passes through a metal box, the box itself must be connected to it, by a grounding screw used for nothing else or by a listed grounding device; passing the conductor through without reaching the box leaves the box unbonded.

rules.title: Two small-appliance circuits
rules.paraphrase: A dwelling's kitchen and dining-area countertop and wall receptacles are to be served by at least two small-appliance branch circuits. Listed here, not checked: the inspector never claims a full inspection.
